sources.locator: PDF p5 section 1.1.1; pp7–10 hazards; Appendix B
sources.finding: Documented system: oxidation-pond treatment, 4,000 EP planning load, 160 ML storage, 45 ha irrigation hardware and 11 collection pump stations. Hazard/response modelling reference; capacity is not measured daily throughput.

sources.title: Narromine annual systems performance report 2025
sources.locator: printed p9 Table 7; p10 section 3.2.1; p24 section 5.1; Appendix 5
sources.finding: 199.24 ML influent; reported daily mean 545.85 kL and maximum 1,694 kL. Reuse scheme reported inactive since 2017. Ten network chokes/blockages in 2025 did not produce reported network overflows. Published process schematic is not a street invert survey.
